basic_info.description: Reduced/Price to sell! Welcome to 1515, a masterpiece crafted by the renowned architect Stanley Saitowitz, nestled in the vibrant heart of the Mission District. This coveted corner residence boasts a spacious living area drenched in natural light, offering breathtaking views of the City Skyline. The kitchen, perfect for culinary enthusiasts, showcases a gas range, ample storage, and a grand breakfast island for gatherings. Large corner windows, slylish floors, designer finishes, and ambient track lighting adorn the 9-foot high ceilings, creating an atmosphere of elegance and luxury. The bedroom features a custom California Closet system, maximizing space and light, while the in-suite bathroom exudes comfort with a sleek soaking tub and stylish vanity. Upon entry, floor-to-ceiling cabinetry provides abundant storage, complemented by an in-unit Bosch W/D with additional overhead storage. Additional amenities include A/C, deeded parking (EV charger can be installed), extra storage & access to a rooftop terrace with panoramic city views, bike parking, and a polished lobby. This sleek 5-story building is ideally situated near the Valencia corridor, offering proximity to an array of popular restaurants, shops, cafes, galleries & nightlife. Bart, shuttle stops, bike paths & freeways
